A chapter with a heavier elite sets its own eliteRoomWaves. 2026-11-09: was 4-6 elites in one wave, about a quarter of an ordinary room; then 4/3/3 (chapter 2 3/2/2), then two waves 5/4 (chapter 2 4/3), now 4/4 (chapter 2 3/3) at the user's word (2026-11-10).

skills.heatSwing: 앞쪽을 넓게 휘둘러 맞은 적에게 불을 붙입니다.
skills.exhaustBurst: 내 주변이 네 번 연달아 터집니다. 터지는 동안에도 움직일 수 있습니다.
skills.frostBolt: 얼음 조각 세 개를 앞으로 쏩니다. 조각은 지나가는 길의 적을 모두 꿰뚫고, 가까이 붙어 쏘면 여러 발이 함께 맞습니다.
skills.coolingField: 노린 곳에 냉기 바닥을 깔아 그 위의 적을 계속 느리게 합니다.
skills.conductiveSpanner: 앞의 적을 때리면 전기가 근처 적 셋에게 더 튑니다.
skills.capacitorStrike: 잠깐 예고한 뒤 노린 곳에 번개가 세 번 떨어집니다.
skills.pressureDash: 짧게 돌진하며 부딪힌 적을 밀어냅니다. 돌진하는 동안은 피해를 받지 않습니다.
skills.vortexIntake: 노린 곳에 회오리를 만들어 적을 끌어모은 뒤 마지막에 한 번 더 때립니다.
skills.ringPalm: 왼손바닥으로 앞쪽을 짧게 울려 적을 밀어냅니다. 공명이 걸린 적에게는 더 세게 들어가고 공명이 두 겹 쌓입니다.
skills.roar: 누르고 있으면 소리를 모으고, 놓으면 앞쪽으로 곧은 음파를 쏩니다. 오래 모을수록 셉니다. 맞은 적에게 공명이 한 겹 걸립니다. 회피하면 취소됩니다.
skills.waterCannon: 물덩이 세 발을 좁게 퍼뜨려 쏩니다. 발마다 지나가는 길의 적을 모두 맞히고 조금 밀어냅니다. 가까이 있는 적은 세 발을 다 맞습니다.
skills.hydroJet: 누르고 있는 동안 커서를 따라 도는 물줄기를 뿜습니다. 줄기 위의 적을 모두 맞힙니다. 뿜는 동안에는 느리게 걷습니다.
skills.prismBeam: 프리즘에서 가는 빛줄기를 앞으로 곧게 쏩니다. 지나는 길의 적을 모두 꿰뚫고 약점을 드러냅니다.
skills.flashBomb: 섬광탄을 던집니다. 떨어진 자리에서 터져 둘레의 적을 드러내고, 일반 적은 잠깐 눈이 부셔 멈춥니다.
skills.scrapShot: 장갑이 쇳조각 다섯 개를 앞으로 좁게 흩뿌립니다. 조각마다 적 하나를 뚫고 지나가고, 가까이서 쏠수록 많이 맞습니다.
skills.magneticLift: 노린 곳 바닥의 쇳조각을 끌어올렸다가 0.65초 뒤 한꺼번에 내리꽂습니다.

fusions.steamShatter: 내 주변에서 뜨거운 김과 냉기가 번갈아 네 번 터집니다.
fusions.arcFurnace: 노린 곳에서 불붙은 전기 폭발이 네 번 이어집니다.
fusions.fireCyclone: 앞에서 생긴 작은 불 회오리가 천천히 나아가며 적을 빨아들입니다.
fusions.magneticIceClamp: 노린 곳에 얼음 집게가 닫히며 가운데 적을 세 번 때립니다.
fusions.frostCrosscut: 두꺼운 얼음 초승달을 바람에 실어 앞으로 날립니다. 지나가는 길의 적을 모두 벱니다.
fusions.stormFloat: 노린 곳에 번개 구슬을 띄우고 잠시 뒤 터뜨려 주변 적을 밀어냅니다.
fusions.overheatResonance: 가까운 적 다섯까지 몸속을 울려 달군 뒤 차례로 터뜨립니다. 터질 때 옆의 적도 함께 탑니다. 한 적은 세 번까지 터집니다.
fusions.highNoteShatter: 노린 곳을 얼린 뒤 높은 음으로 산산조각 냅니다. 얼어 있던 적은 더 크게 깨집니다.
fusions.resonantBolt: 가까운 적 셋까지 낙뢰를 떨어뜨리고, 가장 가까운 적은 2초 동안 스스로 울리며 주변에 방전 음파를 냅니다.
fusions.echoGust: 음파 고리를 날려 보내면 벽이나 끝에서 되돌아옵니다. 오갈 때 한 번씩 벱니다.
fusions.surfaceResonance: 앞에 얇은 물막을 깝니다. 그 위의 적을 렌치나 소리로 칠 때마다 물막 전체가 울려 위의 적이 모두 맞습니다.
fusions.steamVeil: 내 주변이 2초 동안 뜨거운 증기로 덮여, 안의 적이 계속 데고 젖습니다. 증기막은 나를 따라옵니다.
fusions.iceSheet: 노린 곳에 빙판을 깝니다. 위의 적은 느려지고, 2초 뒤 빙판이 한꺼번에 깨지며 크게 다칩니다.
fusions.shockPool: 노린 곳에 전기가 흐르는 웅덩이를 깝니다. 0.5초마다 방전하고, 젖은 적이 많을수록 셉니다.
fusions.waterspout: 노린 곳에 물기둥을 세워 적을 빨아올렸다가, 2초 뒤 한꺼번에 내리꽂습니다.
fusions.noonMark: 커서에 가까운 적 머리 위에 작은 해가 떠서 따라다니며 열빛 기둥을 내리고, 끝에 터집니다.
fusions.frostPrism: 앞에 얼음 프리즘을 세웁니다. 3초 동안 가까운 적 넷에게 굴절된 광선을 쏩니다.
fusions.refractBeam: 커서에 가까운 적에게 광선이 붙어 계속 태우고, 칠 때마다 빛이 꺾여 옆의 적 다섯까지 맞힙니다. 커서를 다른 적에게 옮기면 광선도 옮겨 갑니다.
fusions.lightDash: 빛이 되어 앞으로 미끄러지며 적을 꿰뚫고, 지나온 자리에 남은 빛의 띠가 1초 뒤 터집니다.
fusions.lightConstellation: 가까운 적들을 빛의 줄로 이어 별자리를 그리고, 줄 전체를 다섯 번 울립니다.
fusions.rainbowBridge: 노린 곳에 비구름을 불러 소나기를 뿌리고, 비가 그치면 무지개와 함께 햇빛이 내리꽂힙니다.
fusions.moltenBall: 쇳조각을 모은 달군 쇠공을 굴립니다. 적 무리를 지지며 뚫고 굴러가다 마지막 적이나 큰 적에 달라붙어 터집니다.
fusions.frostShards: 얼음 입힌 쇳조각 여섯 개가 내 둘레를 넓게 돌다가 7칸 안의 가까운 적에게 하나씩 꽂혀 터집니다.
fusions.railCannon: 코일에 전기를 모았다가 앞으로 길게 꿰뚫는 쇠막대를 쏩니다.
fusions.scrapSaw: 고철 톱날을 날립니다. 처음 맞힌 적에 박혀 돌며 베다가, 한 번 튕겨 가까운 다른 적에게 박혀 마저 벱니다.
fusions.ironString: 앞쪽으로 쇠줄을 걸고 다섯 번 튕깁니다. 줄 위의 적이 울릴 때마다 맞습니다.
fusions.ferroVine: 검은 자성 유체가 앞쪽 첫 적의 발밑으로 기어가 감아 오르며 가시로 찌릅니다.
fusions.auroraRing: 머리 위 오로라 고리에서 체력이 많은 적부터 넓은 빛의 커튼이 여덟 번 내려옵니다.

targets.note: How many a move strikes, for the codex: single (one body) or multi (several), and how it reaches them.

burn: 4초 동안 불타며 계속 피해를 받습니다. 3겹까지 쌓입니다.
chill: 3초 동안 40% 느려집니다. 세 번 걸리면 잠깐 얼어붙습니다.
shock: 3초 동안 렌치로 때리면 주변 적 최대 둘에게 전기가 튑니다(8 피해).
windPressure: 4초 동안 렌치에 맞으면 1.5배 멀리 밀리고 경직이 1.5배로 길어집니다. 밀려서 벽·장애물·다른 적에 부딪히면 벽꽝! 부딪힌 몸 모두 피해 15를 받고 0.5초 기절합니다(보스는 밀리지 않습니다).
resonance: 4초 동안 받는 피해가 겹마다 6% 늘어납니다(3겹까지). 3겹에서 소리에 맞으면 공명 붕괴: 30 피해, 주변 일반 적 0.6초 기절, 정예 방패·코팅이 벗겨지고 옆 적에게 공명이 옮겨 갑니다.
wet: 6초 동안 젖은 적이 나에게 주는 피해가 20% 줄어듭니다.
reveal: 4초 동안 약점이 드러나, 이 적에게 맞는 공격의 치명타 확률이 15% 늘고 치명타 피해가 1.5배에서 1.8배가 됩니다.
ironDust: 4초 동안 받는 경직이 겹마다 8% 늘어납니다(4겹까지, 한 번 시전에 적마다 1겹). 4겹이 되면 다음 자력 공격에 쇳가루가 굳으며 50 피해를 주고, 일반 적은 0.8초 굳습니다(같은 적은 4초에 한 번).

twinTickTock.note: Chapter 3 midboss, the metronome twins (docs/design/clock-tower-boss-drafts.md 1-D, src/engine/clock-bosses.js). Two bodies share one health; one acts on each beat (ttBeat in difficulty bossRepeats): red ('tick') on even beats, blue ('tock') on odd. round: what comes next, in order; thrust and dash wait for red's beat, sweep for blue's, pendulum and shuffle take both. 2026-11-15 at the user's word: the colour swap became the shuffle (a shell game: the real Tick bursts, only beside the real Tock is safe), the dash throws gears as it runs instead of Tock's gear ring after it, the conduct (both reel when struck together) is gone, and the pendulum's line runs through F2 (pendulumOverlap past it) instead of down the room's middle. The flank's gaps stay in the middle 60% of the floor, each flankShift to flankShiftMax from the last (2026-11-18: one at the floor's edge, or across the room in one beat, could not be reached). Tick's thrusts reach 4 (2.6 until 2026-11-18, then 3.4, the user's word: a little longer). Damage figures multiply the boss's attack; pendulumDamage is a set amount scaled by the difficulty. At half health the colour floor (phaseBreaks: a columns × rows grid of red and blue squares; need calls of each twin, each callWarn long, stand on the caller's colour; replaced the tether 2026-11-15, the user's idea); then round2 on the quicker beat2 (ttBeat2) with the giant metronome (blade*: the floor under it cut into bladeZones bands, a weight in every band but the free one, which moves one band each swing; bladeSwings swings of ttBladeSwing seconds by difficulty, bladeSwingSeconds if none), the echo (runs under the other blows; echo*: F2's spot marked each beat, blowing echoDelay beats later) and the pincer (2026-11-15). flank (both rounds): they blink to opposite ends and send flankWalls walls of gears across in turn, each with a flankGap gap at least flankShift from the last; in round2 flankWalls2 walls from the same two ends (user's ask, 2026-11-15). 2026-11-19 (the user's word: too easy to dodge): tells about 17% shorter (0.6/0.7/0.9 before), the thrust and dash aim leadSeconds ahead of F2's pace (at most leadMax), now and then a solo blow starts half a beat early (offbeatShare, offbeatShare2 in phase 2), and through phase 2's giant metronome the twin of the beat throws a gear at F2 every overlapBeats beats; the colour floor's squares under the twins are a grey dais (no colour, a miss to stand on). No gem borders on the colour floor (they read as go stones); the caller shows the brass stopwatch (2026-11-19). Until the fight they stand turned south-west (startFacing, 2.356 radians: 135 degrees) with their faces to F2 at the door (2026-11-21, the chapter 3 UI review: the west pose they had hid both faces behind the metronome). 2026-11-20 (the user's word): through the colour floor they stand still in the middle again (a day of gliding round it went); instead through the pendulum and the giant metronome they circle F2 on opposite sides (jointOrbit away, jointTurn a second) and the twin of the beat throws a gear at F2 every overlapBeats beats; the echo blows echoDelay 1.2 beats after its mark (2 before); the pincer gathers in pincerGather 0.45, closes after pincerBeats 3 (4 before) and its gap is pincerGapDegrees 18 either side (27 before).

roar.note: Held: the button charges for up to charge seconds (feet at chargeMove speed, the wrench still swings); letting go, or a full charge, fires a straight sound column halfWidth either side. A dodge cancels it and the wait is half.

hydroJet.note: Held: a stream sprays while the button is held, for at least minDuration and at most duration seconds, turning toward the aim at turnRate radians a second. Every interval it strikes every body on its line (range, halfWidth; "wide" = damage share each), or splashes on a wall. Feet at move speed.

prismBeam.note: A thin straight beam of light out to range at once (the 'beam' shape, as 굉음 without the charge), through every body on it.

flashBomb.note: Thrown at the aimed spot (range): lands after delay and bursts over the skill radius; ordinary bodies hit are blinded (stopped) for blind seconds.

scrapShot.note: Five scrap pellets fanned spread radians apart; each goes through one body and stops at the second (pierceMax, 2026-11-21; it stopped at the first before). 쇳가루 once per cast per body.

magneticLift.note: At the aimed spot: scrap rises for delay seconds and slams down over the radius, laying ironDustStacks of 쇳가루.

overheatResonance.note: Marks up to targets nearest bodies in range (the same one again when there are fewer), each bursting in turn from delay, interval apart, hitting everything within the fusion radius of it.

highNoteShatter.note: At the aimed spot: after delay a freeze (ordinary bodies frozenSeconds), then breakDelay later the shatter. damages are the two blows; a body still frozen takes frozenBonus times the second.

resonantBolt.note: A bolt (boltDamage) on the nearest body in range; it then rings pulses times, interval apart, hitting everything within the fusion radius for pulseDamage. If it falls first, the pulses left go off at once.

echoGust.note: A ring flies out at speed to range (or a wall) and comes back to F2, cutting each body once each way within halfWidth of its path.

surfaceResonance.note: A film of water forward units ahead of F2 for duration seconds. Each time a body on it takes a sound blow or the wrench, the whole film rings (at most once per ringGap) and every body on it takes a hit; hits rings at most.

steamVeil.note: A cloud of hot steam round F2 (the fusion radius), following her for duration seconds; every interval it strikes every body in it.

iceSheet.note: An ice sheet at the aimed spot for duration seconds: firstDamage as it forms, ordinary bodies on it slowed by slow, then it breaks for breakDamage on everything on it.

shockPool.note: A charged puddle at the aimed spot for duration seconds; every interval from delay it discharges into every body in it, wetBonusPer more for each wet body in it (at most wetBonusMax).

waterspout.note: A waterspout at the aimed spot: for slamAt seconds it draws ordinary bodies in (pull units a second) and lifts them, striking every body in it each interval; then it slams them down for slamDamage, stunning ordinary ones for stun. Bosses are not moved.

noonMark.note: A sun over the body nearest the cursor (within cursorReach of it, else the nearest to F2; in range and in her sight) follows it, dropping a heat pillar (pillarRadius) every interval from delay, pillars times, then bursts (burstRadius). If the body falls it moves to the nearest one within hopReach, else stays.

frostPrism.note: An ice prism forward units ahead of F2; every interval from delay, pulses times, it fires a refracted beam at each of the targets nearest bodies within reach of it.

refractBeam.note: A beam fastens on the first body in the aim (acquisitionArc, range) and burns it every interval from delay, ticks times; each tick bends on to the bendTargets nearest other bodies (within 5) for refractDamage each. Since 2026-11-22 it fastens on the body nearest the cursor (within cursorReach of it), else the nearest in the aim's arc, never one behind F2, and is not cast without one; the cursor laid within switchReach of another body moves it there; past leash or behind a wall, or when its body falls, it takes the next by the same rule or ends.

lightDash.note: F2 slides distance units over duration (untouchable for invulnerable), striking each body she passes once; the band she leaves bursts bandDelay later over halfWidth.

lightConstellation.note: Links up to targets nearest bodies in range (F2 and the body when there is only one); rings times interval apart from delay, every linked body and every body on a line (lineHalfWidth) is hit.

rainbowBridge.note: 소나기 무지개 (2026-11-21, replacing the rainbow bridge): a little rain cloud gathers over the spot aimed at (range); from delay it rains every interval, ticks times, over the fusion's radius; then the cloud clears, a rainbow stands over the spot and sunlight strikes at strikeAt over burstRadius.

moltenBall.note: A hot ball rolls from startDistance at speed up to range; each interval it heats bodies within rollRadius (counted only when it touches one, at most rollHits). The first body it touches stops it (any body since 2026-11-21; before, only a boss or elite): an ordinary body with more bodies within aheadReach in its path holds it only clingSeconds and it rolls on; otherwise it clings stickSeconds, then bursts (burstRadius); it bursts at a wall or the range's end too.

frostShards.note: Six iced shards circle F2 at orbit for orbitSeconds, hitting bodies they touch every interval; then each flies (flight) at one of the nearest bodies, shardGap apart, and bursts there over shardRadius.

railCannon.note: Charges for charge seconds, then a rod through every body on a straight line to range (a wall stops it).

scrapSaw.note: A saw flies at speed, cutting each body it passes (flyHalfWidth) once; it lodges in the first body it cuts (any body since 2026-11-21; before, only a boss or elite), a wall or range, and spins there over spinRadius every interval, spinHits times; half-way it springs once to the nearest other body within hopReach and spins out the rest there.

ironString.note: A string from where F2 cast to a big body, a wall or range (following the big body); plucked plucks times interval apart from delay, hitting every body within halfWidth of it.

ferroVine.note: Black fluid creeps at speed to the first body in the aim (acquisitionArc, range; else the range's end), hitting bodies it passes once (travelHalfWidth); then it stabs every interval, stabs times, over stabRadius round that body.

auroraRing.note: A ring over F2; every interval from delay, falls times, a curtain (fallRadius) comes down on the body in range with the most health left, the same one at most sameMax times in a row unless it is the only one.

skillMods.name: 물웅덩이

skillMods.name: 분광
skillMods.description: 광선이 처음 맞힌 적에서 세 갈래로 갈라져 3칸 더 나간다(갈래 피해 40%, 광선에 이미 맞은 적은 빼고).

skillMods.name: 대구경

skillMods.name: 자석 회수

elementTraits.name: 달궈진 틈

elementTraits.description: 화상 걸린 적이 쓰러지면 반지름 1.5 안의 적에게 화상이 2겹 옮는다.

elementTraits.name: 냉각 회수
elementTraits.description: 둔화 걸린 적을 처치하면 기술 대기시간이 1초 줄어든다.

elementTraits.name: 정전 수집
elementTraits.description: 감전된 적을 기본 공격으로 치면 축전을 5 더 얻는다.

elementTraits.name: 뒷바람
elementTraits.description: 회피로 스쳐 지나간 적에게 풍압을 걸고 피해 20을 준다(회피 한 번에 적마다 한 번).

elementTraits.name: 돌풍 고정
elementTraits.description: 풍압 걸린 적이 렌치에 맞으면 경직이 1.5배가 아니라 3배가 되고, 벽꽝 피해가 2배, 기절이 1초가 된다.

elementTraits.name: 과전류 방전
elementTraits.description: 감전된 적이 맞을 때 튀는 방전의 피해가 8에서 14로, 대상이 2기에서 3기로 늘어난다.

elementTraits.name: 빙결 파쇄
elementTraits.description: 둔화된 적을 렌치로 치면 피해가 25%, 얼어붙은 적이면 50% 늘어난다.

elementTraits.name: 긴 여운
elementTraits.description: 공명 지속시간이 2초 늘고, 겹마다 받는 피해가 6%에서 9%로 늘어난다.

elementTraits.name: 렌치 조율
elementTraits.description: 공명 걸린 적을 렌치로 치면 공명이 1겹 쌓인다(같은 적에게 1초에 한 번).

elementTraits.name: 공명 붕괴 강화
elementTraits.description: 공명 붕괴 피해가 2배가 되고, 주변 기절이 1초로 늘며, 공명이 반지름 1.8까지 퍼진다.

elementTraits.name: 흠뻑
elementTraits.description: 젖음 지속시간이 2초 늘고, 젖은 적은 15% 느려지며 받는 피해가 10% 늘어난다.

elementTraits.name: 물튀김
elementTraits.description: 젖은 적을 렌치로 치면 물이 튀어 반지름 1.5 안의 적도 젖는다.

elementTraits.name: 맑은 렌즈
elementTraits.description: 드러냄 지속시간이 2초 늘고, 드러난 적에게 맞는 치명타 확률이 10% 더 늘어난다.

elementTraits.name: 번쩍 처치
elementTraits.description: 드러난 적이 쓰러지면 섬광이 터져 반지름 2.5 안의 적을 드러내고 피해 45를 준다.

elementTraits.name: 자석 렌치
elementTraits.description: 렌치로 치면 쇳가루가 1겹 쌓이고(같은 적에게 1초에 한 번), 쇳가루 걸린 적에게 렌치 피해가 겹마다 6% 늘어난다(최대 24%).

elementTraits.name: 굳힘 파쇄
elementTraits.description: 쇳가루로 굳힐 때(보스는 경직이 들어갈 때) 몸의 쇳가루가 터져 반지름 2 안의 적에게 피해 30과 쇳가루 1겹을 준다.

perks.name: 저금통
perks.description: 방을 깰 때마다 가진 동전의 10%를 이자로 받는다(한 번에 최대 15).

perks.name: 과열 엔진
perks.description: 주는 피해가 30% 늘지만 받는 피해도 20% 는다.

perks.name: 유리 태엽
perks.description: 최대 체력이 15 줄지만 치명타 확률이 20% 오른다.

eliteAffixes.note: Traits dealt onto elites per run (src/engine/encounters.js). Rooms from oneFrom on give each elite one trait, never more.

potions.note: Nasa's oil shelf at Moru's workshop (2026-11-08): opens once chapter 2 is beaten. One bottle is bought with free gears in town and drunk on setting out; it lasts that expedition only, and only one goes along. Buying another swaps it, the first one refunded in full.

list.name: 번개 기름
list.description: 축전이 가득 찬 채 출발, 축전 획득 +15%

list.name: 예비 태엽
list.description: 한 번 쓰러지면 체력 20%로 다시 일어남

difficulty.note: Chosen at the town portal for each expedition. scale multiplies every enemy's and boss's health and attack and the number of room furniture pieces; loot multiplies what each kill and clear pays (gears and coins). 1.0 is the tuning before difficulties existed; easy and hard sit 40% below and above normal. bossRepeats sets how many times Roco and Brass repeat a pattern (stickers, crates, soldier ranks, note rings, stomp rings) on that level. Chapter 2 (2026-11-08): Iris's reject stamps (stampCount, stampCountPhaseTwo) and Press's plates, moulds (moldCount) and guards (guardMax) too; phaseBreaks also tunes the mirrors, pylons and moulds. fewerEnemies (easy) takes one ordinary body out of each fight room's biggest wave; eliteTraits (hard) gives each elite two traits once traits begin. Their openings and memory times too: Iris's counter window (verdictWindow), grid showing time (gridShow), time to find the real one among her decoys (decoySeconds) and lens inspectors joining in phase 2 (lensHelpers); Press's stuck arm (armStuck) and the gap in his closing walls (wallGap).

levels.name: 쉬움
levels.description: 적이 약하고 장애물이 적습니다. 처치 보상도 적습니다.

levels.name: 어려움
levels.description: 적이 강하고 장애물이 많습니다. 처치 보상도 많습니다.

hazards.note: Room furniture dealt per run onto every fight room's floor (src/engine/hazards.js).
hazards.rampNote: The first fight rooms of a run, in order, ease the furniture in: each entry overrides counts (and the saw rails' chance). From the fourth fight on, counts apply as they are.
hazards.musicboxNote: Every expedition finds exactly this many mending music boxes (chapter 1 and 2 alike, 2026-11-09), in fight rooms its seed picks among those whose musicbox count can be above 0, never two rooms in a row and different every run (hazards.js musicRooms). A room's own musicbox count now only says whether it may hold one. Before, each room rolled its own and a run found 3.5 on average. A chapter can set its own total (chapters[].hazards.musicboxesPerRun).
hazards.roomyNote: A fight room whose open floor (walkable less solids, square units) is under roomyArea gets fewer crates and plates in proportion, rounded down, and under 90% of it (270) no fences and no saw rails (hazards.js dealHazards, 2026-11-09): the candy alley A, the repair road A and B, the ribbon crossing, the fountain ring and the candy alley B.

belt.note: Chapter 2 conveyor belt: a strip of floor that carries F2 and enemies (bosses stay put) along it. It turns round every cycle seconds, its arrows flashing red for warn seconds first. Ice stops it for frostSeconds; wind doubles its speed for windSeconds.

press.note: Chapter 2 press pillar: a plate in the floor and a press head hidden in the ceiling above it. idle (only a faint plate shows), then warn (a red ring and a growing shadow; the head drops in its last moment), then it slams down and stands in the way for block seconds. Hurts F2 and every enemy on the plate once a slam and sets off crates on it. Lightning (and sound) brings the slam at once; ice makes it miss its next slam.

laser.note: Chapter 2 inspection laser door: two lens posts (solid) gap apart with a beam between them that is off, then warns (dashed), then on. The beam hurts F2 every tick and each enemy once a beam, stopping it for stopSeconds. Lightning or water shorts it for shortSeconds; sound for soundSeconds.

steam.note: Chapter 2 steam pipe: a pipe overhead (out of the way) whose nozzle dumps steam on a round patch of floor: idle, warn (dashed ring), burst. A burst hurts F2 every tick and each enemy once, and pushes them out by push. Fire raises its damage for fireSeconds, ice clogs it for frostSeconds, water shortens the next burst to wetBurst, wind carries the steam windShift units away for windSeconds.

crane.note: Chapter 2 parts crane: every `every` seconds it marks a ring near F2 and mark seconds later drops a parts crate there: it hurts F2 and enemies under it, sets off crates, and stays as a solid box for boxSeconds (boxHp wrench hits break it). Wind blows the mark windShift units; lightning holds the drop back shockDelay seconds.

elements.note: What each element does to the room hazards (src/engine/game.js elementOnHazards).
